cards.phi: uei le scieng cian, ta dzou lu sciang ban.
cards.itm: Per risparmiare, va al lavoro a piedi.
cards.jam: お金を節約するために、彼は歩いて通勤します。

cards.py: wàn yī xià yǔ, jiù gǎi tiān ba.
cards.en: In case it rains, let's reschedule.
cards.frm: Au cas où il pleuvrait, on reporte.
cards.esm: Por si llueve, lo dejamos para otro día.
cards.phe: wahn ee shyah yu, jyoh gahy tyen bah.
cards.phf: ouann i chya u, djyoou gaï tyenn ba.
cards.phs: uan i shia iu, yiou gai tien ba.
cards.phi: uan i scia iu, giou gai tian ba.
cards.jam: 万一雨なら、日を改めましょう

cards.py: yě jiù shì shuō, wǒ men bú qù le.
cards.en: In other words, we're not going.
cards.frm: Autrement dit, on n'y va pas.
cards.phe: yeh jyoh shr shwaw, waw mun boo chyu luh.
cards.phf: yé djyoou cheu chouo, ouo meunn bou tchu le.
cards.phs: ie yiou shi shuo, uo men bu chiu le.
cards.phi: ie giou sci sciuo, uo men bu ciu le.
cards.itm: In altre parole, non ci andiamo.
cards.jam: つまり、私たちは行きません。

cards.py: bǐ rú shuō, hóng sè jiù bú cuò.
cards.frm: Par exemple, le rouge est pas mal.
cards.esm: Por ejemplo, el rojo está bien.
cards.phe: bee roo shwaw, hoong suh jyoh boo tswaw.
cards.phf: bi jou chouo, hong se djyoou bou tsouo.
cards.phs: bi ru shuo, jong se yiou bu tsuo.
cards.phi: bi ru sciuo, hong se giou bu tsuo.
cards.itm: Per esempio, il rosso non è male.
cards.jam: 例えば、赤色なんかいいです。

cards.py: zǒng zhī, xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù.
cards.en: In short, thank you for your help.
cards.esm: En resumen, gracias por tu ayuda.
cards.phe: dzoong jr, shyeh shyeh nee duh bahng joo.
cards.phf: dzong djeu, chyé chyé ni de bang djou.
cards.phs: dsong chi, shie shie ni de bang chu.
cards.phi: dzong gi, scie scie ni de bang giu.
cards.itm: Insomma, grazie per il tuo aiuto.
cards.jam: 要するに、手伝ってくれてありがとう。

arch.frame: 首先 / 然后 / 最后 + 步骤

cards.py: huàn jù huà shuō, děi děng deng kàn.
cards.en: In other words, we'll have to wait and see.
cards.frm: Autrement dit, il faut attendre de voir.
cards.esm: Dicho de otro modo, hay que esperar y ver.
cards.phe: hwahn jyu hwah shwaw, day dung dung kahn.
cards.phf: houann dju houa chouo, deï deung deung kann.
cards.phs: juan yiu jua shuo, dei deng deng kan.
cards.phi: huan giu hua sciuo, dei deng deng kan.
cards.itm: In altre parole, bisogna aspettare e vedere.
cards.jam: 言い換えれば、様子を見る必要があります。

arch.frame: 换句话说 / 其实 + 说明

cards.kom: 다시 말해 좀 더 지켜봐야 해요

cards.py: shuō dào dǐ, hái shì qián de wèn tí.
cards.en: At the end of the day, it's a money issue.
cards.frm: Au fond, c'est une question d'argent.
cards.esm: En el fondo, es cuestión de dinero.
cards.phe: shwaw dow dee, hahy shr chyen duh wun tee.
cards.phf: chouo dao di, haï cheu tchyenn de oueunn ti.
cards.phs: shuo dao di, jai shi chien de uen ti.
cards.phi: sciuo dao di, hai sci cian de uen ti.
cards.itm: In fondo, è una questione di soldi.
cards.jam: 結局のところ、お金の問題です

cards.py: jì rán rú cǐ, nà jiù zhè yàng ba.
cards.en: In that case, let's leave it at that.
cards.phe: jee rahn roo tsz, nah jyoh juh yahng bah.
cards.phf: dji jann jou tseu, na djyoou dje yang ba.
cards.phs: yi ran ru tsi, na yiou che iang ba.
cards.phi: gi ran ru tsi, na giou gie iang ba.
cards.jam: そういうことなら、それで行きましょう
